title: Forward-travel pedestrian exposure criteria, version 1

run_outcomes.collision: Footprints touch or overlap at any instant.
run_outcomes.near_miss: No contact, but the clearance between the moving forklift and an exposed pedestrian falls below near_miss_threshold_m.
run_outcomes.clear: Clearance stays at or above near_miss_threshold_m whenever the forklift is moving and the pedestrian is ahead of or beside it.

intervention_rule: An intervention is REJECTED for a stress envelope if any executed run inside that envelope is a collision or near miss. It is ACCEPTED only if every executed run is clear.
rationale: 0.5 m is a deliberately lenient clearance: many site rules require 1 m or more between pedestrians and moving trucks. A run below 0.5 m is unacceptable under any common rule, so the threshold does not overstate failures.
